messages:
alex: quick sync — after the authz spike this morning we need clear owners for token rollback impact, audit gaps, and secrets rotation. I sketched a short task list, can folks grab items?

maria: paste the list?

alex: sure —
- verify token validation paths for refresh + session tokens (risk: stale validators)
- confirm RBAC perms edge-cases (service-to-service role escalation)
- audit logging: fill gaps around token revocation events
- schedule secrets rotation for the affected ingress keys in staging/prod
- add recurring detection for token skew regressions in daily incident digest

maria: I'll take "audit logging" and will create INF-459. ETA EOD Thu.

tim: I'll own token validation sweep — will run the `authz-validator` test harness and post failures.

jordan: I'll schedule secrets rotation for staging tomorrow and prod on Friday morning. I'll put a migration playbook in the ticket.

sec-bot: Auto-created follow-ups: INF-459 (audit logging), INF-460 (token-sweep), INF-461 (secrets-rotation) — assigned to maria, tim, jordan respectively.

maria: quick Q — for audit logging, do we want to backfill events from Kafka?

alex: yes, backfill last 72h for tokens and revocations. Use `audit-replay --since 72h` and add results to INF-459.

tim: running the harness now. snippet of failing path: ```
ERROR authz: validator failed for refresh token with missing jti header
stack: auth/validator.go:142
```

jordan: noted on backfill and rotation windows. I'll add a change freeze window and a rollback plan in the ticket.

alex: thanks. two procedural notes: 1) recur detection — Tim, can you add a weekly alert rule that looks for >3 token-related incidents in 7d? 2) owners, please add acceptance criteria to your tickets (logs present, replay verified, rotation completed, and post-rotate smoke tests).

tim: will add alert rule (INF-460) and acceptance criteria. target: add by tomorrow.

maria: adding acceptance criteria now. planning one verification run after backfill.

jordan: rotation playbook + rollback steps added to INF-461. tagging infra-oncall for the prod window.

alex: summarized action items —
• INF-459 — maria — audit logging backfill + verification — ETA EOD Thu
• INF-460 — tim — token validation sweep + weekly alert rule — ETA EOD Wed
• INF-461 — jordan — secrets rotation playbook + prod rotation Friday AM
Please react with :white_check_mark: on the ticket once you finish. We'll re-run postmortem in 1 week to check recurrence trend.

maria: :white_check_mark:

tim: :white_check_mark: starting sweep now

jordan: :white_check_mark: rotation scheduled

alex: great. tagging @sec-oncall to track gating for prod rotation. if anything blocks, call paging channel.

sec-bot: Incident follow-up summary posted to #incidents-log with links to INF-459/460/461.
